method: Independent AI visual reviewer inspected only the three original images and N03 boxes. Prior and new answers, generation prompts and official decisions were withheld. This is an image-based reference, not human-annotated ground truth.

r1.reason: Left bottom box has a visible base inside the registered zone.

r2.reason: Supported directly by r1, whose base is visible.

r3.reason: Front bottom carton base intersects the zone.

r4.reason: Front middle carton visibly rests on r3.

r5.reason: Rear center carton base is occluded by r4.

r6.reason: Immediate support is visible but its path to the ground is occluded.

r7.reason: The base of the lower supporting stack is occluded.

r8.reason: Only a narrow strip is visible above or behind the front carton.

r9.reason: The lower part is hidden by the front cartons and crates.
